subject: MAGIC import in R QTL and genetic map construction

messages.author: ce7abc0f319858d2
messages.subject: MAGIC import in R QTL and genetic map construction
parts:
Dear all,

I have a MAGIC population at the S2 generation (corresponding to selfing twice th 8-way hybrid), derived from 9 founders. I have my founders genotyped but not the exact founders, representants of the genotypes. I have two main questions:

- My genotyping of the S2 is in hapmap format (A/A....), how can I import this format into R qtl and carry QTL mapping

- Secondly, I am working with a specie that deals very badly with homozygosie, therefore there is in the founder, remaining heterozygosie up to 40% for some. How can I construct a genetic map. I have been trying mpmap, but it only accepts full fixed founders and was very complaining about my data.

Thank you very much for your help

Ann

messages.author: 37bf83ea6e1bb5bb
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] MAGIC import in R QTL and genetic map construction
parts:
I think you have to convert the HapMap file in (AA, AB, BB) formate. Then only you can import the file.

I have a doubt whether you can do MAGIC analysis in rqtl or not. For MAGIC you can use mpMap or similar packages like happy or rabbit. 

Thanks 




‌

Thanks & Regards,
Sunil
